answer: Miscellaneous >> Halal & Haram Question ID: 7627 Country: Canada Title: To what extent can I see my mother, sister and daughters uncovered? Question: To what extent can I see my mother, sister and daughters uncovered? Answer ID: 7627 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1798/1502=B/1429) One can see the face, head, chest, arms and shank. It is not allowed to see stomach, back and the part between knee and abdomen. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
